description: A supplied sequence of infinite subsets of the naturals that decreases modulo finite errors has an infinite pseudointersection.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.descending_representatives_pseudointersection (A : ℕ → Set ℕ)
  (hinf : ∀ (n : ℕ), (A n).Infinite) (hd : ∀ (i j : ℕ), i ≤ j → A j ≤ᶠ[Filter.cofinite] A i) :
  ∃ B, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.IsPseudointersection (Set.range A) B
